classification.profile: accepted function/program semantics and bounded variants
classification.physical_type: fixed counts, active routes/MUX, control/ROM, storage, pins and physical views; equal counts alone do not prove equal type
classification.physical_instance: one placed copy of a type; count n fixed before manufacturing
classification.state_type_stateless_reuse: Permitted only if required ROM/control/numeric/MEM/routes are prefabricated and accepted; R-free product can reuse M/N/E/G/S/T instead of idling whole state island.
classification.fixed_heterogeneous_base: Choose all types, n, geometry/pins/routes and active union before freeze; every product has same M1-M10 and PG/CTS; M11/M12 only passive binding/selection of existing resources.

ownership_and_serial_conditions.local_CTRL1: One local ownership domain may contain many sequencers, helpers and arbiters; not one trivial FSM or zero overhead.
ownership_and_serial_conditions.M_A_B_owner: local S loader or prebuilt selected source; never multiple drivers
ownership_and_serial_conditions.M_partial_rule: No same-M gate/up/QK overwrite while down/PV partial must survive; no native merged restore; use actual materialization/recomputation/extra arithmetic or a new M instance with supply mapping.
ownership_and_serial_conditions.N_owner: one local group/phase owner; complete stats/EXP/replay or permitted retained-phase resume before new BEGIN
ownership_and_serial_conditions.E_G_owner: local operand collection/format/tail and G in-flight retirement controller
ownership_and_serial_conditions.S_owner: one ordinary helper plus controlled loader descriptor; capture all read/write ACKs, independent drain progress
ownership_and_serial_conditions.R_owner: one native context owner plus full-layer version service; save output before commit; wait COPY; no revoke of committed active/history
ownership_and_serial_conditions.T_owner: one batch lease owner; fill/seal/commit/read/release; same-T reuse waits actual release
ownership_and_serial_conditions.S1_feeding_M2: one native loader is not two supply ports; prebuilt A/B destination MUX, ready return selection/arbitration and target lock are required

H_complete_main_reference.branch_schedule: one fixed legal serial order, with branch outputs actually stored before native resource reuse
H_complete_main_reference.N_phases: input RMS2560, Attention Softmax, SSM final RMS4096 are scheduled with retained group correctness
H_complete_main_reference.SSM_order: conv bias before SiLU; state/skip then SiLU(Z) gate before full4096 RMS; output projection/scale
H_complete_main_reference.join_owner: H local controller; E only if admitted common S16 arithmetic is sufficient, otherwise real wide add/convert NUM
H_complete_main_reference.state_owner: H local R/version service; one full-layer root, not one root per native tile
H_complete_main_reference.failure: record partial/local commits and publication state; no blind whole-H replay

memory_example.lifetime_reduction_or_MEM_required: actual proof/mapping, not inferred from one S/T instance
